description.text: Information and Computational Science (lCS) at Xidian University is apromising field that blends Computational Mathematics InformationScience, Data Science and Computer Software to address complexchallenges in science, industry, and society This interdisciplinary majoroffers a wide variety of courses from mathematics and statistics tocomputer science.Students majoring in IcS are required to not onlymaster the necessary theories, methodologies, and programminglanguages but also be able to implement their knowledge and skills tosolve practical problems both independently and collaboratively.

duration.text: The Information and ComputationalScience at Xidian University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1：A notarized highest graduation or academic qualification certificate2：Scanned copy of the informationpage of a valid passport3:Scanned copies of the original transcripts4:Language Proficiency Certificate5:Personal Statement or Study Plan6:visa page, and performance certificatesissued by current schools7:Physical examination form8:Certificate of Non-criminal Record9:self-funded applicant must provideFinancial Support Guarantee Statement.10:wo letters ofrecommendation fromprofessors(orassociate professors)11: Conditional AcceptanceLetter of XidianUniversity12: 3-5 minute self-introduction video

requirements.text: 1: Applicants must not have aChinese nationality.2:Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy (free from infectious diseases and any physical or mental diseasethat would have impact on the normal study), and must abide by Chinese laws and regulations, as well as XidianUniversity's school rules and regulations, and respect China's social morals and customs.3:Applicants must be at least 18 years old.4:Language competency 1) lELTS score of 6.5 or above 2)TOEFLscore of 80 or above 3)Duolingo score of105 or above 4)Applicants with a previous degree taughtin English may be exempted from providingEnglish language test scores if theyprovide relevant proof.
